source_version: Effective for SKUs introduced on April 9, 2026; sections 1.1 and 1.2
retrieval: Independent web_extract PDF text retrieval; direct download returned 403. Binary hash unavailable.

definitions.provenance: Paraphrases of section 1.1, not independent eligibility rules. All CI resource types must be represented in the listed classes or descendants and managed by an ITOM application.
definitions.end_user_device: Physical or virtual computing device not defined as another Managed IT Resource Type, with an ITOM component such as Agent Client Collector installed.
definitions.ai_agent: Service for machine learning, data processing and AI-driven tasks.
definitions.service_instance: Interconnected applications and IT resources configured to offer a digital service.
definitions.unresolved_object: IT resource receiving an ITOM event, performance metric or log, not represented as a CMDB CI; recorded in em_unique_nodes with type=unknown. Counting this source is unsupported in this slice.

unresolved_mapping: cmdb_ci_could_database is literal source text; no corrected mapping is assumed.
limitations: CMDB populations are not managed or billable counts, nor a ceiling.
Managed-by-ITOM eligibility and product scope are unverified.
End-user devices require an installed ITOM component and exclusion of other resource types.
Container/image relationship exclusions are not evaluated.
Rounding and contract applicability are unknown.
Observed 90-day usage and purchased entitlements are not implemented.
